title: Null and Void
subtitle: Missing values in the hospital records could cost lives
conceptSummary: NULL means 'no value'. Use IS NULL / IS NOT NULL to find them, and COALESCE to replace NULLs with a default.

dialogue.text: Welcome to the Cleanup Crew! This world is about messy data — NULLs, duplicates, typos. The hospital has appointments with missing diagnoses.
NULL is dangerous in medical records. Find all appointments with no diagnosis recorded. That's negligence or tampering.

teachMoment.title: NULL: The Missing Value
teachMoment.body:
NULL means 'no data'. To find NULLs:

SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE diagnosis IS NULL

To replace NULLs with a default:
SELECT COALESCE(diagnosis, 'Not recorded') AS diagnosis

⚠️ You cannot do: WHERE diagnosis = NULL (this doesn't work!)

task.instruction: Find all appointments where the diagnosis is NULL (not recorded). Show appt_id, patient_id, and appt_date.
task.startingQuery:
SELECT appt_id, patient_id, appt_date
FROM appointments
WHERE diagnosis IS NULL
task.solution: SELECT appt_id, patient_id, appt_date FROM appointments WHERE diagnosis IS NULL

hints.text: You can't use = NULL. Use IS NULL instead.
SELECT appt_id, patient_id, appt_date FROM appointments WHERE diagnosis IS NULL

winDialogue.text: Found them! Appointments with NULL diagnosis are the ones that were tampered with. The fee was also not recorded.
The pattern: SHADOW42 operatives booked appointments, modified records, then erased diagnoses to cover billing fraud.

storyBeat: NULL values as a weapon: the criminal network erased diagnoses to manipulate hospital billing. Every NULL is a clue. The data tells the truth, even in its silence.
